# Ashutosh Gupta

> Ashutosh Gupta is a Software Developer (Full Stack, Android and Cross-Platform Mobile) specializing in Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP/CMP), Jetpack Compose, Flutter, Angular, NestJS and Firebase. He builds production apps with ~85% shared code across Android and iOS, plus full-stack web/ERP systems. Currently Full Stack Software Developer at Digital Dream Systems. Open to full-time roles and freelance/contract work.
